annotation_relationship: HL-0041 / HL-0041a: debt layer, carrying amount 0.189 USD billion at June 30, 2026, not 0.23 or the December 2025 0.273. Trigger field mentions the 12 percent multiplier; this is not a default probability or necessarily a cash coupon. Collateral_type n/a in the dataset is not proof of legal unsecured/equal ranking.
material_unknowns: Selected notes do not disclose relative priority, collateral or complete termination/redemption timing.
Twelve percent is the stated return/effective rate, not a supplied cash-coupon schedule; dated carrying amounts are not future payoff estimates.

judgment_guidance.equity_holder: Assess conditional cash allocation and commercial/service economics without estimating undisclosed returns.
judgment_guidance.senior_unsecured_creditor: Assess conditional liquidity, competing claims and recoverability without inventing claim priority.
judgment_guidance.both: Separate unknown from zero; do not confuse cap, carrying value and payment schedule. Recognized source IDs are not semantic citation verification.
